opportunities.title: Regular Grant – under £100,000
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), exempt and excepted charities; must have at least one year of audited or examined accounts; must pass the eligibility quiz.
opportunities.summary: Open to applications year‑round for operating/core cost, capital project or specific activity grants of up to £100,000. Grants typically support 10‑20% of an organisation’s annual budget and can be for one‑to‑three‑year periods.

opportunities.title: Major Grant – £100,000 and over
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Organisation must have annual income over £1 million or total project/capital costs over £1 million; must be a UK registered charity, CIO or exempt/excepted charity; must have at least one year of audited or examined accounts; must pass the eligibility quiz.
opportunities.summary: Major Grants of £100,000 and above are considered at eight board meetings per year. They can fund capital or project costs (minimum total cost £1 million) or core costs for organisations with income over £1 million. Expressions of interest can be submitted any time and are reviewed on a rolling basis.
